cases.purpose: Reject compound-starttls-bind filter before any connection or bind side effects
cases.oracle: Independent RFC 4511/4532 BER vectors and bounded one-connection loopback peer. The peer records exact requests, supplies predetermined result messages, and checks close/ordering. OpenSSL validates the throwaway TLS certificate in TLS cases.
cases.comparison: Failure with a filter diagnostic and no accepted connection, including with TLS and bind options.
cases.candidate_script:
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/transfer-ldap-peer-r2.py
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" serve invalid-filter > "$HOME/peer.out" 2> "$HOME/peer.err" &
peer=$!
for ((i=0;i<80;i++)); do [[ -s "$HOME/peer-port" ]] && break; /bin/sleep 0.05; done
[[ -s "$HOME/peer-port" ]] || { wait "$peer"; echo 'peer did not bind'; exit 98; }
port=$(<"$HOME/peer-port")
builtin ldap search -H "ldap://127.0.0.1:$port" -b dc=ex -ZZ -D cn=alice -y /nonexistent/ldap-password "(&)" cn > "$HOME/client.out" 2> "$HOME/client.err"
rc=$?
printf 'status=%s\n' "$rc"
wait "$peer"; printf 'peer-status=%s\n' "$?"
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" check invalid-filter
/bin/grep -q "LDAP filter" "$HOME/client.err" && printf "diagnostic=yes\n" || printf "diagnostic=no\n"
